scope: Post-gate independent checks that supplement, but do not rewrite, the accepted stage receipts.

thesis_export_numeric_equality.reason_for_tolerance: The thesis export intentionally rounds metrics to six decimal places.

checks: all true_ and pred_ cells are finite and exactly in {0,1} before any integer cast
all prob_ cells are finite and within [0,1]
every primary pred_ cell equals prob_ >= 0.3
perfume_id, fold_id, source_group_id, and all seven true-label columns are paired identically across models

deep_dataset_deterministic_rebuild.method: Rerun the accepted transcript-only builder from the frozen raw CSV, frozen labels, and accepted fold manifest into temporary files, then compare SHA-256 bytes.

bert_checkpoint_cache_provenance.qualification: The accepted runner used local cache files but did not prospectively pin an immutable revision; the supplemental record identifies the revision and bytes observed immediately after the run.

artifact_byte_anchor.coverage: Every regular file below the experiment root except SHA256SUMS itself.
